summary: Mongolia, Kazakhstan, Afghanistan and Bolivia come first; Chad, Niger, Mali and Ethiopia reward a look at Africa's map, and Switzerland, Austria and Paraguay are the famous misses.
reasons: Builder's own replay, pending a real judge. A casual found 6 and lost lives on Switzerland (#31), Austria, Paraguay (#15), Nepal and Hungary, each with its area.

A country with a coast costs a life and shows why: "Brazil: 7,491 km (coastline)", "drc" is the Democratic Republic of the Congo, "37 km (coastline)" (CIA figures). Kazakhstan counts as landlocked: its only coast is on the Caspian.
47 landlocked countries and de facto states: a casual runs dry after about a dozen, so it is no Blitz.
